skill_name: Write a news article about gender diversity in computing.
workflow: A recent report conducted by the IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers) has revealed that gender diversity in computing has not improved over the last decade. The report attributed the lack of progress to gender stereotypes, lack of access to learning opportunities, and unequal representation.
